summary: Applies an affine 4x4 matrix transform to a 3-component input vector: for each output component i, a1[i] = a2[0]*a3[i] + a2[1]*a3[4+i] + a2[2]*a3[8+i] + a3[12+i], where the a3[12..15] terms embed the translation. a2 is read only as a 3-vector, so the fourth homogeneous coordinate is implicitly 1 (point semantics, not direction). Computes components 1-3 into temporaries v3/v4/v5, writes all four output components at this+0x0..+0xC, and returns a1. Pure coordinate-transform helper with no branches, globals, or callees; structural twin of F_4DAffineTransform (0050c525) per packet prelabel and sibling TransformVectorByMatrix4x4 (00517653).

local_names.a3: 4x4 affine matrix, flat float[16], translation in a3[12..15]

operations.description: v3 = a2[0]*a3[1] + a2[1]*a3[5] + a2[2]*a3[9] + a3[13] (output component 1, matrix row/column index 1).
v4 = a2[0]*a3[2] + a2[1]*a3[6] + a2[2]*a3[10] + a3[14] (output component 2, matrix row/column index 2).
v5 = a2[0]*a3[3] + a2[1]*a3[7] + a2[2]*a3[11] + a3[15] (output component 3, matrix row/column index 3).
a1[0] = a2[0]*a3[0] + a2[1]*a3[4] + a2[2]*a3[8] + a3[12] (output component 0, matrix row/column index 0).
